UserWalletProfile.title: UserWalletProfile
UserWalletProfile.description: Authenticated user's SpinMint wallet balance, spin quota, energy, daily streak, and profile metadata.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the wallet owner.

lastSpinResetEpochDay.description: UTC epoch day of the last spin quota reset.

nextAdAvailableEpochMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when the next bonus spin ad unlocks.

lastEnergyUpdateMs.description: Timestamp in epoch milliseconds of the last energy update.

lastCheckinEpochDay.description: UTC epoch day of the last claimed daily reward.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

WalletTransactionRecord.title: WalletTransactionRecord
WalletTransactionRecord.description: Immutable ledger entry for SpinMint coin deposits and reward withdrawals.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the transaction owner.

methodName.description: Payment rail name (UPI, Paytm, PayPal, Crypto (USDT)).

accountIdentifier.description: Masked/entered payment destination or wallet label.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when transaction was recorded.

AdminCommissionRecord.title: AdminCommissionRecord
AdminCommissionRecord.description: Immutable 1% platform commission record generated from player winning payouts.

playerUid.description: UID of the player whose winning generated the 1% admin commission.

playerName.description: Public display name of the winning player.

sourceGame.description: Game or earning mode name (e.g., Lucky Spin, Ludo, Teen Patti).

grossWinCoins.description: Total winning payout before the 1% admin commission.

commissionCoins.description: 1% commission coins credited to the app admin.

netPlayerCoins.description: Net winning coins received by the player.

inrValue.description: INR cash equivalent of the admin commission.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the commission was recorded.

AdminTreasurySummary.title: AdminTreasurySummary
AdminTreasurySummary.description: Admin-only treasury state tracking claimed commission coins.

claimedCoins.description: Total 1% commission coins already claimed into the admin wallet.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) of latest admin claim.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-scoped SpinMint wallet and gameplay progression document.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Append-only ledger of user deposits and withdrawal requests.

/admin_commissions/{commissionId}.description: Append-only 1% winning commission ledger readable exclusively by the app admin.

/admin_treasury/{docId}.description: Admin-only treasury summary tracking claimed commission coins.
